prompt: Edit this Vishnu illustration only to correct CLOTHING. Preserve the exact monumental square low-angle composition, blue face and four arms, two eyes, crown, radiant sunlit gold background, all FOUR separate traditional attributes (discus, conch, mace, lotus), dhoti, lake and original painterly style. Replace ALL bare blue chest and abdomen from base of neck to waist with one clearly recognizable FULLY OPAQUE embroidered golden silk fitted traditional upper tunic, high neckline, covering shoulders, chest, ribs and abdomen without any cutout. The tunic must show obvious fabric texture, seams, folds and gold embroidery so torso cannot read as bare skin painted gold; keep garlands and jewels on top of it. Blue face, forearms and hands may stay visible. Exactly four arms, no added limbs; no nudity, text, watermark, logo or border. Only change torso clothing, everything else unchanged.
initial_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original square premium naturalistic painterly illustration of VISHNU for Mythics, respectful living Hindu sacred iconography. Majestic radiant benevolent Preserver, immense divine presence. A dramatic low-angle full-body composition from a lotus lake below the shining golden jeweled architecture of Vaikuntha on Mount Meru; distant buildings and mountains tiny compared with his imposing figure. Vishnu has ONE human head, TWO eyes, exactly FOUR separately readable arms, TWO legs, deep natural blue skin. Give each of his four hands exactly one traditional attribute, clearly separate and anatomically connected: upper right holds a golden Sudarshana DISCUS, upper left holds a white CONCH SHELL trumpet, lower right holds a golden MACE, lower left gently holds a pink LOTUS flower. Crown and traditional ornaments; entirely opaque modest silk upper garment covers chest, shoulders and abdomen; opaque dhoti and drapery cover hips and legs. Serene dignified expression and statuesque active stance, living deity not a statue. Strong warm golden SOLAR RADIANCE illuminating his whole silhouette and the discus, motivated by his documented association with the sun; coherent shafts of warm daylight, not fire or lightning or blue energy. Rich cinematic contrast against cool blue mountain atmosphere, refined tactile painterly detail in textiles and ancient golden buildings. Scale, posture and solar lighting are original editorial interpretation of accepted iconography and Vaikuntha setting. Do not add Shesha, Garuda, Lakshmi, other avatars or additional heads/eyes/limbs, no unrelated powers. No nudity, gore, text, inscriptions, label, border, logo or watermark. Entirely original design; no resemblance to films, games, anime or comics.
